`final class UIKeyEvent<U extends UI>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`UIInputEvent<U>`](/reference/events/uiinputevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.ui` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIKeyEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/ui/UIKeyEvent.java)

The event of `handleKeyPressed` and `handleKeyReleased` on a UI, with the key that the layout names and its place on the keyboard.

### getKey

### getPhysicalKey

`Key getPhysicalKey()`
